identity.name: Tsuyosa
identity.one_liner: The sub-$400 integrated-bracelet automatic that brought the Royal Oak/Nautilus design language to the entry tier — Citizen's answer to the Tissot PRX.

narrative.story: The Tsuyosa (Japanese for "strength") is Citizen's integrated-bracelet entry, launched in Japan in 2021. The 40mm stainless steel case, the integrated bracelet, and the in-house 8210 automatic (40-hour reserve, 21,600 vph) give it the same design language as the Tissot PRX at a comparable price. The crown is integrated into the case side (a flush push-pull design). The Tsuyosa is the most-cited modern Citizen in the enthusiast community and the watch a collector cites when they want an integrated-bracelet automatic under $400.
narrative.collector_notes: The Tsuyosa uses the 8210 — an older Citizen automatic caliber, not the newer 09X series. The integrated crown sits flush with the case side; pulling it out requires a fingernail.
